correctness.rationale: The generalized Cayley graph on S_6 is reconstructed from all 70 generalized transpositions. Breadth-first search proves the complete distance distribution and diameter; a complete Bron–Kerbosch search over the resulting 720-vertex compatibility graph proves maximum clique size 6 and exactly 6000 maxima. Every structural statement is then directly checked on the complete list. The packaged verifier replays these steps without external dependencies.

value.rationale: The finding gives an exact and complete finite benchmark for a metric whose literature emphasizes general constructions and the difficulty of distance computation. It determines not only the optimum but every labeled extremizer, their equidistance, the exceptional subgroup maxima, and the natural left-action orbit structure. Those data are reusable for testing bounds, constructions, and algorithms at the smallest scale of this nontrivial instance.
